name: What size of drywall damage can be patched, and when is full replacement necessary?
description: Small holes and cracks can be patched; larger damage often requires replacement. A professional can assess the best repair.

mainEntity.name: What size of drywall damage can be patched, and when is full replacement necessary?

acceptedAnswer.text: Small holes, cracks, and minor dents (typically under 6 inches in diameter) are ideal candidates for patching. This usually involves applying joint compound and sanding smooth. Larger damage, such as widespread cracks, significant water damage, or holes larger than a foot, often requires cutting out the damaged section and installing a new piece of drywall. This ensures structural integrity and a seamless finish, preventing future issues. A professional assessment can determine the most effective repair method.
